reason: My site still shows last year's prices and I am sick of giving Viator and GetYourGuide a fifth of every booking; €600 is what I lose in commission on a handful of transfers. The domain is in my name and there is no long contract, so if it brings me even a few WhatsApp bookings a month it has paid for itself.
objection: A nice website does not bring tourists by itself. Viator puts me in front of people, a website only works if they find me on Google, and I am not sure it will move bookings away from the platforms.
